# tgo

Package main provides the TGo command.

The command takes one directory inside a Go module and calls the compiler. The driver finds the module root, writes generated Go beside TGo inputs, and checks the result. There is no output\-directory option.

Use Go's normal build, test, and run commands after compilation. Test and platform suffixes stay at the end of generated filenames so Go selects the same files. Ordinary source, assets, and dependencies remain at their paths. Language rules and file writes belong to the compiler.
